: Device not working, SCB offline
Troubleshooting: I
have checked the charger on SCB and found that it is online on the OCPP backend, with all outlets currently busy charging EVs. 0372053
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
